targetLicenseScope: Project-authored source code; Clear marks and artwork remain separately licensed or reserved unless the rights holder grants otherwise.

findings.finding: The public contributor history and local commit-name aliases show substantive human commits attributed to the repository owner account; no separate external human contributor was found in the reviewed history.
findings.limitation: Account attribution and owner statements are provenance evidence, not independent legal proof of title to every historical line.

findings.finding: Three Dependabot commits are mechanical dependency/workflow updates; no substantive bot-authored application feature remains. Devin PR #4 surviving changes are cleanup/build text and manifest metadata; PR #5 is tracked separately.
findings.limitation: A bot sign-off is not a human contributor attestation.

findings.finding: The vendored Lucide subset has the upstream ISC license and the MIT exception for Feather-derived icons. The ambiguous music vector has been replaced with the official list-music paths, pinned to an upstream commit.
findings.limitation: The original snapshot for the complete helper is not pinned; only the replacement list-music path was independently matched in this pass. These icon licenses do not clear any first-party brand or product artwork.

findings.finding: Generated dependency inventories and SBOM are generated metadata, not executable product code. Tauri schema/build outputs under src-tauri/gen/ are excluded from the authored source manifest and source archive.

src-tauri/tools/catalog-test-vectors/v1/test-private-key.base64 is explicitly documented beside its paired public key as a public TEST ONLY vector, not a production secret or credential. The README forbids bundling it in an app/runtime; it remains in the source archive only as a public test fixture.
The reviewed source search found no additional vendored source/snippet set or conflicting Apache/proprietary first-party source header beyond the separately recorded Lucide subset.
findings.limitation: Repository text search cannot establish the origin of every line by itself.

findings.finding: The owner explicitly approved distribution of the 62 retained Clear brand, extension identity, and installer-art files on 2026-09-25. Clear branding remains outside GPL.

The owner explicitly approved distribution of the 8 retained platform and Store icon files on 2026-09-25; check:asset-provenance verifies the grouped attestation. Five obsolete purple logos from early app versions were removed at the owner's direction; current Tauri/MSIX configuration does not consume them. The generation command/tool version is not recorded, but the owner's rights declaration covers distribution of these outputs.

The owner explicitly approved distribution of the 95 retained file-type, news/support, player-control, and documentation artwork files on 2026-09-25. Two obsolete placeholders and five obsolete purple platform logos were removed.

The owner approved distribution rights for the 165 retained images in a grouped declaration dated 2026-09-25; the SHA-256 is verified by check:asset-provenance. This is a cross-cutting union, not an additional family.
All 73 graphics with REMOVE dispositions are confirmed absent from the current tree; two related Android XML support files were also removed.

The code-license metadata, full COPYING text, NOTICE, TRADEMARKS, and contribution metadata are consistent about GPL applying to project-authored source code and Clear marks being outside that grant. Asset clearance verifies distribution permission separately.

The public PR/session chain and exact diff are recorded. The rights holder directly declared the account to be personal self-service, denied any owner-known Enterprise MSA/Order Form/custom modification, declared continued use after the 30-day transition, and approved GPL distribution of code the owner has rights to license. Cognition Platform Terms 2026-06-30 §§1.2, 1.5, 3.1 and 12.4 support the ownership/applicability basis.
findings.limitation: The account classification and absence of separate agreements rely on the direct owner declaration; no account-specific click-through timestamp/log or independent legal opinion is represented. The PR #5 owner review is recorded and hash-checked in rights/release-rights.json.
